sentences.en: Eventually the salesman persuaded me to buy the expensive machine.
sentences.zh: 最终那个售货员说服了我买下了那台昂贵的机器。

sentences.en: A good salesman will not encroach on his customer's time.
sentences.zh: 一个优秀的售货员不会占用顾客的时间。

sentences.en: He disguised himself as a salesman and visited her house.
sentences.zh: 他装扮成一名售货员去拜访她的家。

senses.zh: 销售员(注:复数形式为sales men)
